data.title: [Incident (Recovered)] Network Access Abnormality for Some Cloud Products in Zone B, Indonesia (Jakarta) Region

eventUpdates.content: 17:25 All affected cloud products have been recovered.
At 16:02, the ISP's network line was restored, and the affected cloud product services are being gradually recovered.

At 15:36, the ISP has preliminarily identified the cause of the network anomaly and initiated on-site emergency repairs. Alibaba Cloud engineers are continuously following up and coordinating on the incident.

At around 13:05 Beijing time, products with high-availability architecture, such as ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and Message Queue (MQ), have achieved rapid recovery in accordance with the emergency response plan after the anomaly occurred. For the other affected products (Elastic Compute Service (ECS), Block Storage, etc.), some instances depend on the progress of network recovery, and Alibaba Cloud engineers are working at full capacity to handle the incident.

Dear Customer,

Starting from 12:55 Beijing time on July 28, 2026, Alibaba Cloud monitoring has detected an abnormality in network access for some cloud products in Zone B, Indonesia (Jakarta) region. Alibaba Cloud engineers are urgently handling the incident. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
